Response to Milestone 2 Feedback
Thank you for the feedback. Here's the evidence addressing each point:
Repository is the same: https://github.com/en7angled/Decentralized-Belt-System.git 
1. Smart Contract Deployment Evidence
Added Admin Command Line Tools:
・Functional CLI: admin deploy-reference-scripts deploys validators
・Test Evidence: test_evidence_preview.txt shows successful deployment on testnet + tesnet transactions

・Complete Installation & Setup: Step-by-step deployment instructions
・Usage Documentation: All admin commands and configuration requirements
・Extensive Contract Documentation:
・Blueprint: bjj-belt-system-blueprint.json contains complete CIP-57 specifications

Automated Test Script:
・test_black_promotes_white_to_blue.sh: Specifically created for reviewers so they can execute this script to verify smart contract functionality on testnet.

1. Project Summary
The Decentralized BJJ Belt System is a comprehensive web application that enables the decentralized management of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) belt promotions and achievements on the Cardano blockchain. The system provides a user-friendly interface for practitioners, instructors, and organizations to track progress, award belts, and maintain transparent records of martial arts achievements.
Project Repository:
・Website: https://github.com/en7angled/bjj-dapp-web 
・Cadano Blockchain Integration: https://github.com/en7angled/Decentralized-Belt-System 

2. Final Milestone Outputs & Deliverables
2.1 Core Application Features
・ Complete Web Application: Full-stack Next.js application with TypeScript
・ User Authentication: Cardano wallet integration and profile management
・ Profile Management: Practitioner profile creation and editing
・ Belt Management: Complete belt promotion tracking and verification system
・ Public Profile Viewing: Browse and view all community profiles
・ Responsive Design: Mobile-first, accessible interface design

2.2 Technical Infrastructure
・ Blockchain Integration: Native Cardano wallet support and transaction signing
・ Dedicated Cadano Integration Service for transaction building and blockchain data projections
・ API Layer: Secure backend communication with authentication
・ Database: Persistence for profile metadata
・ File Storage: Optimized image upload and management system
・ Performance: Efficient caching and loading states

2.3 User Experience Features
・ Namemap System: Automatic profile ID resolution to human-readable names
・ Image Management: Profile picture uploads with fallback placeholders
